abacus-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.description: Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management is an engineering college at Natungram, Mogra in Hooghly district, run jointly by the JIS Group and Techno India Group.
abacus-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.about: AIEM was established in 2008 as a joint venture of the JIS Group and Techno India Group. It offers B.Tech programmes affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology and diploma courses under the state technical education council. All its programmes are approved by AICTE.
abacus-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

academy-of-technology.description: Academy of Technology is a private engineering college on G.T. Road at Adisaptagram in Hooghly district, West Bengal.
academy-of-technology.about: AOT was established in 2003. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal. It offers B.Tech programmes and a Master of Computer Applications course.
academy-of-technology.address: G.T. Road (Adisaptagram), Aedconagar, Hooghly, West Bengal 712121
academy-of-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

camellia-institute-of-technology-and-man.description: Camellia Institute of Technology and Management is an engineering college beside G.T. Road at Bainchi in Hooghly district, West Bengal.
camellia-institute-of-technology-and-man.about: CITM was set up in 2009 by the Onkar Society for Engineering and Technological Research and Development. It sits on an 11 acre campus at Halder Dighi, Bainchi. It is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (formerly WBUT), and its courses are approved by AICTE.
camellia-institute-of-technology-and-man.address: Halder Dighi, G.T. Road, Bainchi, Hooghly, West Bengal 712134
camellia-institute-of-technology-and-man.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

govt-college-of-engg-and-textile-technol.description: Government College of Engineering and Textile Technology, Serampore is a government engineering college in Serampore, Hooghly, with roots as a textile technology college founded in 1908.
govt-college-of-engg-and-textile-technol.about: The college began in 1908 as the College of Textile Technology, Serampore. It sits on William Carey Road in the historic former Danish settlement on the Hooghly river. Today it offers computer science and engineering, information technology, textile technology and apparel production management. Its B.Tech and M.Tech programmes are approved by AICTE and affiliated to MAKAUT.
govt-college-of-engg-and-textile-technol.address: 12 William Carey Road, Serampore, Hooghly, West Bengal 712201
govt-college-of-engg-and-textile-technol.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

hooghly-engineering-and-technology-colle.description: Hooghly Engineering and Technology College is a private engineering college on Vivekananda Road, Pipulpati, in Hooghly town, West Bengal.
hooghly-engineering-and-technology-colle.about: HETC was established in 2004. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal. It offers B.Tech programmes along with BCA and BBA courses.
hooghly-engineering-and-technology-colle.address: Vivekananda Road, Pipulpati, PO and Dist Hooghly, West Bengal 712103
hooghly-engineering-and-technology-colle.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

supreme-knowledge-foundation-group-of-in.description: Supreme Knowledge Foundation Group of Institutions is an engineering and management college at Mankundu near Chandannagar in Hooghly district.
supreme-knowledge-foundation-group-of-in.about: SKFGI was founded in 2009 by the Supreme Knowledge Foundation Trust. Its campus covers about 10.4 acres close to Mankundu railway station. It offers B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA and diploma programmes approved by AICTE and linked to MAKAUT.
supreme-knowledge-foundation-group-of-in.address: 1 Khan Road, Mankundu, PO Chandannagar, Dist Hooghly, West Bengal 712139
supreme-knowledge-foundation-group-of-in.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

calcutta-institute-of-technology.description: Calcutta Institute of Technology is a private engineering college at Banitabla, Uluberia in Howrah district, West Bengal.
calcutta-institute-of-technology.about: CIT was established in 2004. Its campus lies along the national highway near Uluberia railway station. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology for degree courses and to the state technical education council for diplomas.
calcutta-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

indian-institute-of-engineering-science-.description: IIEST Shibpur is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, located beside the Botanical Garden in Shibpur, Howrah.
indian-institute-of-engineering-science-.about: The institute traces its origin to the Civil Engineering College started on 24 November 1856. It later became Bengal Engineering and Science University, Shibpur. In March 2014 an Act of Parliament converted it into an Institute of National Importance under its present name. Its green campus of about 49 hectares lies on the Hooghly river next to the AJC Bose Indian Botanic Garden.

mckv-institute-of-engineering.description: MCKV Institute of Engineering is an autonomous engineering college on G.T. Road at Liluah, Howrah, with NAAC A accreditation.
mckv-institute-of-engineering.about: MCKVIE was established in 1999. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, and works as an autonomous institute under the UGC Act. It holds a NAAC A grade, and several of its B.Tech programmes, including CSE, ECE, EE and IT, have received NBA accreditation.
mckv-institute-of-engineering.address: 243 G. T. Road (North), Liluah, Howrah, West Bengal 711204
mckv-institute-of-engineering.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

omdayal-group-of-instituitions.description: OmDayal Group of Institutions is an engineering and architecture college in the Uluberia Industrial Growth Centre, Howrah district.
omdayal-group-of-instituitions.about: The college was established in 2010. It is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology and holds approvals from AICTE and the Council of Architecture. It offers engineering, architecture and management programmes and has been accredited by NAAC.
omdayal-group-of-instituitions.address: Plot No. 38(P), 38(A), 39(P) and 39(A), Uluberia Industrial Growth Centre, Uluberia, Howrah, West Bengal 711316
omdayal-group-of-instituitions.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal
